IncidentsBot: Pager alert: org 'saffron' (org_id: org_87324) experiencing sustained QPS spike + rising 5xxs. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/saffron-traffic?from=now-30m

Jordan: I'm oncall, looking now. Can someone surface breakdown?

Alex: Seeing ~3x baseline QPS since ~10:40 UTC, majority embedding requests (batching heavy). 95th latency up but errors are primarily rate-limit/502 retries. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:40:12Z saffron req_total=1180 rps embeddings=820 95p=1.2s errors=2.1%
2026-03-15T10:41:05Z saffron req_total=1375 rps embeddings=950 95p=1.4s errors=3.8%
```

OpsBot: Suggested mitigations (priority): 1) temporary org RL bump 2) increase org quota for 15m 3) per-route throttle for embeddings 4) block bulk-embedding endpoint if abuse suspected. Recommended command: 
```
/admin/rl adjust --org org_87324 --qps 60 --duration 15m --reason "emergency spike"
```

Jordan: @Priya can you approve temporary bump to 60 qps for 15m? We'll monitor and roll back automatically. Cost hit unknown but needed to avoid customer 5xx.

Priya: +1 from support side to avoid customer outage. Notify account lead as soon as bump is applied. :thumbsup:

Maria: I'm the AM for Saffron — please CC me on comms. We haven't heard from them yet, I'll ping their SRE and let them know we're doing an emergency mitigation.

Samir: Running the adjust now. Executing:
```bash
$ /admin/rl adjust --org org_87324 --qps 60 --duration 15m --reason "emergency spike - oncall Jordan"
> ok: policy updated (audit_id=aurora:241999:88af)
> active_limit: 60 qps (was 20) expires_at: 2026-03-15T11:05:34Z
```

OpsBot: Audit log recorded: event=org_rl_change actor=Samir audit_id=aurora:241999:88af method=manual

IncidentsBot: Noting mitigation: temporary org RL increase applied. Monitoring metrics for stability.

Alex: Metrics update ~3m after bump — errors down to 0.6%, p95 back under 800ms. Traffic still elevated but stable.

Jordan: Good. We'll keep the bump for the requested window; plan to auto-revert. @Samir can you leave a note on the incident ticket with cost estimate once available?

Samir: Will do. Early cost delta rough calc: +$1.6k for the 15m window (est). I'll attach more accurate numbers to INC-241999.

Lia: Quick thought — this looks like legitimate user load (embedded usage patterns), not clear abuse yet. If errors resurge after bump, we should consider disabling bulk-embed for org or applying per-request token cap. For now keep the service on.

Jordan: Agreed. No feature disables yet. If we see repeated spikes we'll schedule a quota uplift or capacity reservation conversation with Saffron's account team. Maria, pls coordinate.

Priya: Noted — I'll draft an immediate notification to Saffron saying we applied a temporary mitigation and are investigating root cause. Will include expected revert time and invite them to a follow-up call.

Alex: One more data point: origin IP distribution is consistent with Saffron's known IP blocks, so likely internal traffic pattern change (customer-side batch job).

OpsBot: Revert scheduled at 2026-03-15T11:05:34Z unless extended. To extend run:
```
/admin/rl extend --audit aurora:241999:88af --additional 15m --actor Samir
```

Jordan: We'll monitor 30m post-revert. Assigning follow-ups: Priya -> customer comms, Maria -> coordinate uplift/contract change if needed, Alex -> gather traces & evals for root cause, Samir -> cost breakdown & attach audit logs. I'll keep incident open for 1 hour and close after monitoring looks clean.

IncidentsBot: Incident timeline updated, ticket INC-241999 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-241999

Samir: Attached audit + initial cost estimate to INC-241999.

Alex: 12 minutes after mitigation: errors stable at 0.3%, throughput normalizing. No other orgs impacted.

Jordan: Good work team. Leaving a note: when we do postmortem, check if we can auto-detect sudden batch-job patterns and alert account team earlier (pre-mitigation).

Lia: Optional: add a per-org preemptive token cap toggle in console (low friction for AMs) — filing a feature request.

OpsBot: Incident status: mitigation successful; monitoring for 1h. Follow-ups created: INC-241999 -> tasks: customer-comms, cost-report, traces, and long-term mitigation feature request.

Jordan: Closing thread here for now — will update once revert completes. Thanks everyone. :riot_heart:
